capabilities.description: Track ingredient and finished-product stock levels, movements, wastage and reorder points across all five bakery shops, with per-shop views and cross-shop transfers.
Maintain a product catalogue with unit prices, cost sheets, margins and price list versions, and compute derived prices and profitability per product and per shop.
Assign ~30 daily deliveries to drivers and vehicles, sequence routes, and track delivery status, completion and exceptions in near real time.
Record and report running costs for 10 bikes and 2 cars — fuel or charge, maintenance, insurance and per-delivery cost — with per-vehicle and per-driver cost roll-ups.
Provide a consolidated management dashboard covering sales, stock health, delivery performance and fleet costs across all locations, with drill-downs and scheduled reports.
Manage manager and driver accounts, roles and permissions, shift and capacity planning, and workforce records for the 5-shop, 12-vehicle operation.
Ingest recipes, cost sheets, price lists and delivery procedures uploaded by management, index them, and answer natural-language questions grounded in those documents with citations.
Define operational procedures and checklists per shop and per delivery run, assess readiness before service, and maintain an immutable evidence trail of actions and checks for audit.
